phase_3_bloc_kingmaker.description: The Bloc holds the master key. Theriault (ETHI vice-chair) + Savard-Tremblay (NDDN vice-chair) can swing both committee votes. Blanchet as kingmaker can demand reform as confidence condition.

targets.send: Full evidence brief + both parties' dirt + Quebec framing
targets.hook: Blanchet's price is always Quebec sovereignty: immigration powers, mandatory French, supply management protection. Anti-corruption as confidence condition fits his 'Ottawa is corrupt, Quebec deserves better' framing. His stated position: 'the federalist parties and us must be capable of working together in the face of a crisis.' The lobbying data IS the crisis.
targets.known_demands: Full immigration transfer to Quebec, mandatory French for citizenship, supply management protection. He imposed Oct 2024 deadline on Trudeau and followed through. He WILL use leverage.
targets.timing: Contact AFTER Phase 2 allies are recruited. Blanchet needs to see that reform has cross-party momentum before he commits.
